model_annotation:
The three top plots illustrate different training dynamics metrics over a shared x-axis representing training progress. The shared x-axis is labeled "Steps," features a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 500, and has regularly spaced numeric tick intervals of 100.

The leftmost plot represents Outcome Training Rewards. The y-axis is labeled "Outcome Training Rewards," uses a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 1.0, and has a tick interval of 0.2. A solid teal line representing "On-policy RL" begins near 0 at step 0, rises sharply to approximately 0.6 by step 100, and then trends steadily upward with minor fluctuations, ending at roughly 0.85 at step 500. A solid dark red line representing "LUFFY" starts near 0, briefly dips downward (indicated by a text label "Adapting to External Guidance"), then climbs rapidly to approximately 0.7 by step 100, continuing an upward fluctuating trend to reach roughly 0.95 at step 500. Both lines display shaded regions around them indicating variability.

The middle plot illustrates Response Length. The y-axis is labeled "Response Length," features a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 2000, and has tick intervals of 500. A solid teal line for "On-policy RL" begins near 100 at step 0 and remains relatively flat, showing only slight variations, ending near 200 at step 500. A solid dark red line for "LUFFY" begins near 100 at step 0, experiences a steep increase (annotated with "Imitating Off-policy Traces") to a local peak of roughly 1250 at step 100, and then exhibits high-amplitude fluctuations mostly between 750 and 1250, concluding near 1000 at step 500. A solid yellow-orange line representing "Off-policy Reasoning Traces" starts at approximately 1750 at step 0 and maintains a steady, highly fluctuating horizontal trend generally between 1500 and 1800, ending near 1650 at step 500. All lines include surrounding shaded regions.

The rightmost plot illustrates Entropy. The y-axis is labeled "Entropy," utilizes a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 1.0, and has tick intervals of 0.2. A solid teal line for "On-policy RL" begins at approximately 0.9 at step 0, undergoes a steep, smooth decline to roughly 0.2 by step 100, and then gradually levels off, ending near 0.05 at step 500. A solid dark red line for "LUFFY" starts near 0.9 at step 0, drops steeply to about 0.4 by step 100, and then continues a gradual but highly fluctuating downward trend. It features a prominent secondary peak of about 0.5 near step 310, which is annotated with an arrow and the text "Continuous Exploration," before declining to conclude at approximately 0.2 at step 500.

The two bottom-right plots illustrate training performance on different dataset subsets over a shared x-axis. The shared x-axis is labeled "Steps," employs a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 500, and has tick intervals of 100.

The upper of the two bottom plots represents training rewards on an easy subset. The y-axis is labeled "Training Rewards," features a linear scale, has drawn marks ranging from 0.0 to 0.2, and has tick intervals of 0.1. A solid teal line for "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" begins at roughly 0.0 at step 0 and ascends sharply and steadily, exiting the top of the plotted area above 0.25 around step 160. A solid dark red line for "Llama-LUFFY-Easy" starts near 0.0 at step 0, follows a very similar steep upward trajectory, and also exits the top bounds of the plot near step 170.

The lower plot, titled "Hard Training Set," illustrates training rewards on a hard dataset subset. The y-axis is labeled "Training Rewards," uses a linear scale, ranges from 0.0 to 0.2, and has tick intervals of 0.1. A solid teal line representing "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" starts near 0.0 at step 0, rises insignificantly in the first few steps, and remains entirely flat near 0.0 through step 500. A solid dark red line representing "Llama-LUFFY-Hard" begins near 0.0 at step 0, rises smoothly to approximately 0.12 by step 100, and proceeds with an upward, moderately fluctuating trend to end at roughly 0.22 at step 500.
